configuration.worldWrites: explicit offline, one ordered apply/recover invocation at a time
configuration.osFileCache: uncontrolled; full/refresh does not flush the OS file cache

scanInput.recipe: corpus.json S, its six declared files plus fixtures/control/level-java121.dat
scanInput.metadataMeaning: GZip NBT DataVersion 3953 with overworld/nether/end dimension registry; synthetic, not playable

scanTruth.slotRule: pack-000/001 en_us keys fixture.line.000000..000127 have exact value Fixture PPP/en_us/NNNNNN ‖§‖ and language.value context
scanTruth.sameRootProjection: data excluding telemetry, cacheBefore and execution; retain all source/snapshot identities
scanTruth.portableProjection: also remove data.worldId, data.snapshotId, sources[].location.artifact.worldId and items[].address.artifact.worldId; retain all sources, diagnostics, counts, scope, addresses and text
scanTruth.portableJson: PowerShell 7 ConvertTo-Json -Depth 100 -Compress, UTF-8 without BOM or final newline

workflowControls.scope: Public cases indexed by docs/capabilities.md, plus cli-session-write-public-legacy-through-seal and architecture suite
workflowControls.settings: Preserve each case's explicit input/worker settings. scanWorkers=1 applies to the separate serial scan control; cases run sequentially in isolated workers.
workflowControls.canonicalTruth: Case assertions fix exact typed values, protected bytes, complete slot/operation sets, receipts, recovery identities, raw restores and session completion; random temporary paths are not semantic outputs

comparisonRule: Preserve complete workload, diagnostics, bindings and canonical truth before comparing time/allocation/RSS. G07 must add size-specific workflow workloads and freeze inputs/thresholds before optimization.
statusBoundary: Correctness only; no speedup, RSS, sustained-operation, Minecraft, power-loss or release acceptance. The immutable original six-file corpus lacks live world metadata and is not itself a valid public world scan.
